## Investigation Report

### Verdict/Confidence/Severity/Task Type

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Confirmed underlying parser gap; cited throw path is not reproducible literally on the frozen snapshot |
| Confidence | High |
| Severity | Medium |
| Task Type | Correctness review remediation |

### What Was Claimed

Issue #194 carries finding `correctness-argv-1` from PR #192: selector-command scanning can reject valid Yarn shorthand scripts when a later argument is `workspace` or `workspaces`; `["yarn", "build", "workspace"]` was cited as the reproduction.

### What We Found

The frozen `staging` snapshot at `723b0bca407fbc66dd41e5607e012618f4c6ca22` contains `packageScriptName` in `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts`. It recognizes `test`, `run`, and `run-script`, but has no `scriptCommandSeen` scanner and no arbitrary Yarn shorthand handling. Consequently, the literal `yarn build workspace` input does not throw in this snapshot; it returns no script name and skips package-script validation. The underlying contract gap remains: shorthand scripts are not statically validated, and a scanner that treats every `workspace` token as a selector would misclassify a trailing script argument.

### Root Cause

Package-manager argv parsing is command-position unaware for Yarn shorthand. Only explicit script forms establish the script command, while Yarn's supported `yarn <script> [...args]` form is omitted. Selector words must be interpreted only in command position, never as later script arguments.

### Affected Files

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` | Recognize and validate Yarn shorthand while preserving selector rejection at command position. |
| `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` | Add regression coverage for shorthand scripts with trailing `workspace` and `workspaces` arguments, plus selector behavior. |

### Evidence

- `packageScriptName` currently returns a script only for `test`, `run`, and `run-script`.
- `assertNoPackageManagerOptions` already provides the fail-closed option scan to reuse after a recognized script command.
- Existing tests reject npm package selectors/options and validate package-local scripts, but contain no Yarn shorthand cases.
- `.forge/config.json` requires `npm run check`; no additional local verification command is configured.

### History Findings

The issue identifies PR #192 and finding `correctness-argv-1` as the source. The frozen snapshot includes the related package-script preflight hardening and its npm selector regression tests, but not the cited `scriptCommandSeen` implementation or Yarn shorthand tests. No unrelated history or files are needed for this remediation.

### Recommendation

Implement a minimal Yarn-aware argv parser: recognize a shorthand script only at `argv[1]`, reserve Yarn selector commands at that position, reject unsupported selector invocations, scan only subsequent tokens for unsupported options, and validate the package manifest script. Add focused tests proving `yarn build workspace` and `yarn build workspaces` are accepted when `build` exists, while command-position selectors remain fail-closed.

### Related Issues

- Source issue: `#111`
- Source PR: `#192`
- Remediation issue: `#194`

### Decomposition Assessment

This is a single-file parser correction with one focused test-file update. No decomposition is warranted.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] Validate the reported Yarn shorthand behavior against the current integration snapshot.
- [ ] Recognize valid Yarn shorthand scripts without treating later `workspace`/`workspaces` arguments as selectors.
- [ ] Preserve fail-closed handling for selector commands and unsupported package-manager options.
- [ ] Add focused regression coverage.
- [ ] Run the required `check` verification and obtain a fresh review of the remediation head.
